title: PDEA intercepts suspected marijuana shipment at Laguna courier hub

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) seized suspected marijuana products during a K9-assisted inspection at a courier hub in San Pablo City, Laguna, on Friday night, Oct. 30. In a report on Saturday, PDEA Region IV-A said agents from its Seaport Interdiction Unit-Batangas conducted the inspection at 8:30 p.m. in Barangay San Vicente. The operation led to the discovery of suspected marijuana products concealed in parcels intended for shipment.
